A private record of who showed up, and what they did.

TLC exists to make care and contribution visible between people who trust each other, and to keep the record of it beyond the reach of a quiet edit. It is for families, small circles, community groups and cooperatives: anyone who wants a trustworthy memory of who showed up for whom, without handing that memory to a company.

The record lives on this device as a text file you can read. Every entry carries a SHA-256 hash of the entry before it, so changing one entry breaks the rest. You can export the record and check it with the ledger-verify command-line tool in the source repository.
There is no account and no sync. Records do not leave this device unless you export or share them. Steward approvals, dyads and growth grants are the next milestone.
